messages.subject: mi.scaled
parts:
Hi all, 

I'm using Lavaan version 0.5-17 and for an analysis I requested the modification indices. I noticed something I didn't see before: the mi.scaled. Does anyone know in what way the MI are scaled and what it means? 

Thanks in advance and kind regards, 

Josephine.

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: mi.scaled
parts:
On 11/03/2014 04:47 PM, josephin...@gmail.com wrote:
> Hi all,
>
> I'm using Lavaan version 0.5-17 and for an analysis I requested the
> modification indices. I noticed something I didn't see before: the
> mi.scaled. Does anyone know in what way the MI are scaled and what it
> means?

You will see this if you have used a 'robust' test statistic (eg
Satorra-Bentler). Then, it is possible to 'correct' the modification
indices too, by dividing them by the scaling factor. The result is in
the mi.scaled column.

Yves.
